scope: Fresh 85-observation heading-hold task development; task/observation/reward change together. This is not a single-factor PPO algorithm benefit experiment and does not complete G1.

task.provider: default oracle; actual source schema and full provider configuration recorded from reset
task.additional_changes: No PI, action transform, terrain preview, path feedback, path reward, GAE change, critic pretraining or BC initialization.

training.checkpoint_timing: after full PPO.train update has returned; no save at pre-update rollout callback
training.checkpoint_continuity: one uninterrupted learn(65536) call per seed; do not reload weights, reset the active environment, or evaluate in the training process during learning
training.command_support: straight forward only; user yaw rate is always zero, so arbitrary turns are outside trained support
training.policy: stock SB3 MlpPolicy; fresh 85-input actor and critic

ppo.remaining_defaults: record instantiated PPO settings and installed dependency versions

counting.definition: PPO _n_updates counts optimization epochs, not independent 128-transition rollouts. Saved checkpoint steps are subsets of the final budget, not additional samples.

curriculum.rule: at reset: min(3, (4 * actual_transitions) // 16384); maintain active episode terrain until its next reset
curriculum.level_zero: default flat terrain regardless of terrain index
curriculum.nonzero_level: multiply slope, cross-slope, ripple amplitude and step height by level/3; keep other terrain parameters
curriculum.rng: three independent SeedSequence(seed).spawn(3) streams for level draw, terrain index and episode seed; no evaluation draws during training

training.exposure: record actual transitions per level, complete and nonempty partial episodes, termination reasons, and geometric nonflat exposure separately; zero-step automatic resets and reload probes are not training transitions
training.stopping_rule: do not stop or change seeds/parameters for poor performance at 16384; stop only for implementation, numerical, source-identity or counting failures and record every partial run without replacing it silently
training.prelaunch_checks: all 77 source_sha256 entries in results/d1_budget_study/protocol.json match; targeted environment/runner tests and actual small PPO save/reload smoke pass; record current new source and model/metadata hashes before and after each run
training.reload_checks: all six checkpoints: exact weights and deterministic action match, valid 85-observation actual step in a separate environment after learning; six extra physics steps reported separately

development_evaluation.holdout_policy: Only this previously opened development road is evaluated now. No newly frozen holdout is opened; prior final cases are not treated as unseen.
development_evaluation.policy_execution: each policy predicts deterministically from its own current live 85-observation; no replaying another policy actions; first termination ends evaluation without reset or padding
required_metrics: final x/y and separate x-boundary/y-boundary/fall diagnosis
cross-track absolute peak and signed final offset
new task return, servo return and heading-goal contribution separately
development_evaluation.comparison: report all seeds and both budgets, with every failure retained. For each policy-versus-zero and same-seed 16k-versus-65k comparison also report strict common observable prefix metrics using raw traces; do not pad after termination, compare only surviving trials, or select the best checkpoint.
development_evaluation.gate_interpretation: Use previously proposed G1 straight-road thresholds as development indicators only. This one road does not validate stopping, turning, disturbances, GUI integration or full G1. Do not claim causal gain from the three added observations or reward alone.

next_decision: After all six development checkpoints, inspect completion, heading and cross-track together with speed and height. Continue targeted fixes or broader G1 validation based on remaining failures; do not automatically increase to 262144 or start jump/speed claims.
